From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Helen Park <helen.park@acme-industries.com>, Acme Purchasing <acme-purchasing@acme-industries.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Committed spend — invoice phasing & monthly drawdown runbook

Hi Helen / Acme purchasing team,

Following up from last week's call — attached is a proposed operational runbook for your annual committed prepay (RDW-ACME-2026-001). The goal is to minimize manual coordination on our side while giving Acme clear visibility into monthly drawdowns and VAT treatment.

Key points in the attachment (Redwood_Annual_PrePay_Schedule.xlsx):
- Annual committed amount: USD 1,200,000, invoiced as a single upfront prepay.
- Drawdown cadence: monthly allocation based on usage (first business day of each month).
- Billing phasing: we propose a single upfront invoice (net 30) with monthly internal drawdown records; external invoices for accounting only at quarter boundaries if you require.
- VAT handling: we need confirmation of Acme’s VAT registration and whether reverse-charge applies — see the VAT checklist tab.

Ask: Please confirm PO number to put on the upfront invoice and whether Acme prefers:
  A) Quarterly external invoices for GAAP purposes, or
  B) Single upfront invoice + internal monthly drawdown ledger only.

I've also included a small CSV template (RDW-Acme_Drawdown_Template.csv) showing the monthly sweep format our billing ops will post to your AR team. If this looks good we can:
  1) Finalize PO and VAT details,
  2) Redwood invoices the upfront prepay,
  3) Redwood sends monthly drawdown ledger and a one-line transaction record each month for your reconciliation.

Attaching sample invoice PDF so you can preview line items (Invoice_Sample_Redwood.pdf).

Happy to jump on a 20-minute call tomorrow to walk through.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Annual_PrePay_Schedule.xlsx (xlsx), RDW-Acme_Drawdown_Template.csv (csv), Invoice_Sample_Redwood.pdf (pdf)

From: Helen Park <helen.park@acme-industries.com>

Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Committed spend — invoice phasing & monthly drawdown runbook

Jordan — thanks for the package and the clear materials. A few quick clarifications from Acme finance: 

1) VAT: Acme is VAT-registered in the UK (GB123456789). We are usually handled via reverse charge for services from US vendors — we can provide a VAT certificate if required.
2) PO: We will issue a single PO for the full committed amount; PO number will be provided by procurement by EOD Wednesday.
3) External invoices: Our accounting team prefers quarterly external invoices for audit trails (option A on your note). However, we also need the monthly ledger detail for internal chargebacks.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: (a) put the PO number on the upfront invoice, (b) issue quarterly external invoices with the monthly ledger attached, and (c) mark the invoice as reverse-charge where applicable?

Cc'ing Oliver from ProcureX — he handles our VAT evidence intake and will advise if we need additional documentation.

Regards,
Helen Park
Head of Finance — Acme Industries
helen.park@acme-industries.com

- VAT / reverse charge: Redwood will mark the invoice as reverse-charge where customer VAT registration is provided. Please send the VAT certificate to finance-ops@redwood.com (cc'd).
- Quarterly external invoices + monthly ledger: Redwood will issue the single upfront invoice at contract execution, then produce quarterly external invoices (Q-report) for Acme's external audit needs. Monthly drawdown CSV will be posted to the secure Drive link and emailed to your AR contact on the first business day of each month.

Operational next steps: 
1) Acme confirms PO by EOD Wed (Helen).
2) Acme shares VAT certificate to finance-ops@redwood.com.
3) Redwood invoices upfront on receipt of PO and VAT evidence.
4) Ben Carter (cc) will send the first monthly drawdown ledger on 1 Jun 2026.

I've attached an updated schedule with the VAT column filled out and the sample invoice flagged for reverse-charge language. If you want a short call I can set 20 minutes with Marissa (CS lead) and Ben (billing ops) to walk through the reconciliation template.

Best,

- Marissa: please confirm the operational owner for posting the monthly CSV to the secure Drive link (we want it to be automated via billing pipeline).
- Vivek / Olga: once PO is received I need a single upfront invoice drafted (net 30) with reverse-charge language option and PO number. Use Invoice_Sample_Redwood.pdf as template; include payment instructions for wire and remittance.

Thanks — Jordan
